evidence: The growth of HfO2 from initial submonolayer coverage to continuous HfO2 film is studied by means of Rutherford backscattering, static time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectroscopy, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The Hf content was measured by means of RBS. XPS was performed... TOF-SIMS was used... Ellipsometry was used... TEM samples were prepared... STEM/HAADF imaging... AFM... XRD... SEM... LEIS.
